evidence.dom: 『Our suite of advanced products, coupled with our unique process control software and services, allow us to deliver the solutions our customers』『comprehensive portfolio of inspection, metrology and data analytics products』=プロセス制御の主導的地位。ただしhitsに明示的シェア%記載なし→全社プロセス制御シェア約55%(寡占40-69%)として保守的に70。中核の光学検査は>70%だが全体基準で判定
evidence.irr: 『due to increases in the installed base of KLA systems. Our services revenue, which is generated largely from recurring 「subscription-like」 contracts, increases the value』+『service revenues by 15%...primarily attributable to the growth of our installed base』=装置のfab認定+据付ベース連動の高摩擦。明示的な規格認証ロック文言はhitsになく70(高摩擦移行困難)
evidence.rep: 『these customers may reduce the need for our products and make it easier for our China-based competitors to develop and sell their own products and take market share from us』(複製が試行段階)+『unique process control software』=複製は極困難だが中国勢が挑戦中→80
evidence.dur: 『unique process control software and services』『comprehensive portfolio of inspection, metrology and data analytics products, and related services, helps IC manufacturers achieve target』=数十年蓄積の検査・計測プロセス知/技術=100(プロセス知/物理)。据付ベースのスイッチングコスト(75)も併存する複合堀
evidence.erosion: 『make it easier for our China-based competitors to develop and sell their own products and take market share from us』=中国国産化による競争侵食が萌芽=emerging
evidence.disrupt: 蝕セクションに技術代替(disrupt)のヒットなし。プロセス制御はEUV/GAA/先端実装で複雑化し需要増『innovation and growth of new technologies like AI, with that region recording 27%...of total revenues』=技術代替の脅威なし=settled
evidence.expiry: 限=『The process of seeking patent protection is lengthy and expensive...pending or future applications will actually result in issued patents』=特許は継続更新型のポートフォリオで単一満了の崖なし。コンセッション型でもない=no
evidence.geopol: 『one customer accounted for approximately 19% of total revenues』(FY2025・前年13%)+『decrease in revenues from our customers in China, accounting for 33% of total revenues in fiscal 2025 compared to 43% of total revenues in fiscal 2024』+『International revenues accounted for approximately 89% of our total revenues』=対中輸出規制・台湾/TSMC集中・89%海外=重(2)
evidence.moatdecay: 『increase in service revenues by 15%...growth of our installed base』+FY2025売上過去最高12.16十億+据付ベース拡大=堀の構造劣化なし=no(中国国産化は要監視)

evidence.p1: ROIC5年σ(ASR踏襲=のれん込み基準)。のれん込みROIC 2021-2025=32.2/43.2/40.5/29.2/42.3、σ=5.7pt→<6pt=80。opmσは2.0ptと極安定。のれん除き基準ではσ約12pt(自社株買いのIC分母薄化による増幅)だが返り自体は安定
